Good to know

How early should I order?

At least 2 days ahead. For large boxes or events, order a week early.

Do you deliver?

Yes, delivery is Rs. 150 within the city. Pickup is free.

How do I pay?

Pay on pickup or delivery. We confirm your order first over Instagram or WhatsApp.

Can I change my order?

Message us at least 24 hours before your slot and we'll update it.
